attribution: Measured by shibbo from one-shot pages generated with measure/generate-ui.ts

method.features: measure/ui-features.mjs: headless Chrome at 1440x900 and 390x844, thresholds documented at the top of the file
method.layout: correspondence analysis of the API, no system prompt model x token table (symmetric map); pages and the other route's models placed as supplementary rows
method.owns: 4+ of the model's pages, 2x and +25 points over the other models' share, one-sided Fisher p < 0.05 (unadjusted)
method.drift: per family with 4+ releases: token share in the first third of releases against the last third; Spearman rho of share against release order
method.wrapper: same model through the API and through Claude Code: distance between its two points, mean absolute change in token share, tokens that moved most

limits: Makers in the main set: claude, deepseek, gemini, gpt, meta, minimax, mistral, moonshot, nvidia, qwen, xai, xiaomi, zhipu.
One page per brief and model, so a token in 4 of 24 pages may be chance; owned tokens are leads.
No human-built baseline yet, so the map shows how models differ from each other, not from people.
Tokens come from fixed thresholds on computed styles; a page can meet a rule in letter and miss it in spirit. Thresholds sit at the top of measure/ui-features.mjs.
Pages render without network images, so photo-led designs read by what is left.
8 replies came back JSON-escaped (literal \n and quotes); shibbo measured an unescaped copy: Claude Opus 4.6 8.
